warning: service pihole: cap_add was dropped: Incus has no per-capability option; privileged is the blunt instrument
warning: service pihole: environment FTLCONF_webserver_api_password looks like a secret and is written as it is: add it with `tink secret set` and write ${secret:NAME} instead
note: service pihole: ./etc-pihole was a path relative to the compose file; it is now the managed volume pihole-etc-pihole. Write it as a bind mount to keep it a directory you can see
note: service pihole: container_name is ignored: the instance is named for the service, which is the name siblings use
